## Unsupported (5)

Refused at deploy with a diagnostic. A refusal is evidence of a truthful diagnostic, never of support.

| ID | Candidate | Section | Limitations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FLOW-08 | Parallel event-based gateway | 13.4 | Refused at deploy with rule `event-gateway.kind` on the gateway (`eventGatewayType="Parallel"`); a stored definition reloads as the exclusive choice it compiled to (ADR-0177). No parallel event-gateway semantics run. CON6 candidate. |
| FLOW-09 | Instantiating event-based gateway | 13.4 | Refused at deploy with rule `event-gateway.kind` on the gateway (`instantiate="true"`); no instantiating event gateway runs. CON6 candidate. |
| FLOW-10 | Complex Gateway | 13.4 | Refused at deploy by name as `<complexGateway>`, anchored on the gateway element (ADR-0547); never interpreted as another gateway kind. CON6 candidate. |
| ACT-12 | Ad-hoc Subprocess, sequential ordering | 13.3.5 | An ad-hoc subprocess with `ordering="Sequential"` is refused at compile (ADR-0138); only parallel ordering runs. CON6 candidate. |
| EVT-05 | Process-root Conditional Start | 13.2 | A process-level conditional start is refused with rule `start.conditional`; conditions run only inside an instance (intermediate catch, boundary, event subprocess, ADR-0137). CON6 candidate. |

## Known deviations

Behaviour atlas chose deliberately where the specification says otherwise or leaves the outcome to the engine; each is decided in the cited record.

| ID | Candidate | Deviation | Decided in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DEV-01 | EVT-38 | A terminate end event at the process root ends every other token and then completes the instance: its state is completed, not a separate terminated state. | [0116](../docs/adr/0116-terminate-end-events.md) |
| DEV-02 | FLOW-13 | An exclusive gateway whose conditions are all false and which has no default raises an incident and keeps its token parked, where the specification speaks of an exception; resolving the incident retries the decision. | [0273](../docs/adr/0273-gateway-routing-incident.md) |
| DEV-03 | EVT-35 | An error no handler catches raises an incident on the throwing element and parks it, instead of ending the process abnormally. | [0089](../docs/adr/0089-error-events.md) |
| DEV-04 | FLOW-14 | A definition stored before ADR-0547 that contains a refused sequence-flow shape still loads and routes as it was compiled, including a gateway default that names another gateway's flow; only its next deploy is refused. | [0547](../docs/adr/0547-refuse-forbidden-sequence-flow-shapes.md), [0177](../docs/adr/0177-reload-skips-the-deploy-gate.md) |
